title: Remotion player
description: Your own Remotion component (the kind lessons 2 and 3 render to video) played inside the page by @remotion/player and seeked frame by frame by the stage. Without a component the kit's own composition plays: a frame ruler that counts its own frames.

props.component: your .tsx next to story.json (default export = the component); empty = the built-in frame ruler
props.caption: one line under it
props.label: built-in ruler: the small line above the number

example.label: A Remotion composition
example.caption: The components you render to video also play on a slide and on a web page.
